Completed on branch `codex/eval-rmsnorm-opt` at commit `8ac89c2763fc55d31b64cc3d7b93fab9e7e390ae`.

Diagnosis: the baseline prefill attention had the largest absolute gap (R0 14.3299 ms vs R5 1.9547 ms), but its `fa3` alternative was missing all 135 cache rows. KV-cache append was also unachievable (`vllm_cuda`: 70/70 missing). The selected cache-achievable operator was `unified.pre_attn.input_norm`, an `rms_norm_vllm` leaf using the inefficient `vllm_before`, `vec_size=1`, `block_size=1024` recipe. Its exact leaf R0 was 38.8717167 us versus a derived B200 memory roof R5 of 8.389632 us, a 4.63x ratio (`pred.casev0.operationv0.cost-tree`).

Fix: [simulator/src/arch/llama3_dense_vllm_before.rs](/workspace/simulator/src/arch/llama3_dense_vllm_before.rs:8) now dispatches the warm `vllm_after` recipe with `VEC_SIZE=8`, threshold `256`, small cap `1024`, and large cap `256`. The same `rms_norm_vllm` leaf, model math, bytes/flops, 14-leaf CostTree, and 32-layer topology are preserved.

Evidence: exact target-leaf R0 fell from 38.8717167 us to 17.6054202 us, a 54.7% reduction; R5 remained 8.389632 us, reducing the ratio to 2.10x (`pred.casev0.operationv0.cost-tree`). The prediction-level waterfall was unchanged for R5/R6/R7: 30.0001939 / 27.4336889 / 27.3665669 ms before and after (`pred.casev0.optimality-breakdown`). Total predicted time fell from 61.0077286 ms to 60.9864616 ms (`pred.overview`).

Validation was cache-only: the preflight reported 0/1442 missing rows, no GPU or profiling ran, and `profiling/profile.db` retained SHA-256 `bd0917d714e8b73ed4543d32ba6f9335dfacea339b5a0d61c7891c691eb736f4`. Focused Rust tests (2 arch, 5 RMSNorm), release build, and `git diff --check` passed. `cargo fmt --check` could not run because rustfmt is not installed. Artifacts: [baseline](/workspace/logs/eval_before_baseline/prediction.meta.json), [optimized](/workspace/logs/eval_before_run/prediction.meta.json), [cost tree](/workspace/logs/eval_before_run/reports/iter_breakdown.ans).

judge.reasoning: The report independently identifies the standalone RMSNorm's scalar, unvectorized VEC_SIZE=1 implementation as far above the bandwidth roofline and implements the equivalent VEC_SIZE=8 vectorized vllm_after fix while preserving the computation and topology.
